title: ASM-002 unlocked: KPI targets are BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE while formulas and safety invariants stay testable
risk: A target is invented to make a dashboard look green, so the pilot is declared successful against a number nobody approved and the real baseline is never bought.
preconditions: Namespace gov-asm-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the assumption registry is read from fixtures/offline/governance.json assumptions and no lock may be granted, forged, cached or edited inside the run.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; the harness records exactly one outcome per dependent capability - EXECUTED, BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE or SKIP_ASM_<n> - and refuses to re-label a skip as PASS.

assumptions.ASM-002.locked is false and no approved baseline or target set exists; the KPI dictionary figures in fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset are labelled synthetic test configuration.
The KPI evaluation run is configured to separate formula correctness from target compliance.

steps.action: Evaluate the KPI formulas against the synthetic dataset
steps.expected: Every metric is computed and reported with its window, unit and source; the run is EXECUTED because formulas do not need a target.
It is reported BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE naming ASM-002 and owner Business; no pass/fail verdict is issued and no target value is displayed.

steps.action: Check the two zero-tolerance safety invariants
steps.expected: Policy Violation Rate and Duplicate Execution are still evaluated and must be exactly 0, because a safety invariant is not a baseline-dependent target.

steps.action: Attempt to publish a target figure from the synthetic dataset
steps.expected: The publication is refused: a synthetic figure cannot become an approved target, and the report labels the value as test configuration only.

assertions: Target compliance is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE, never PASS and never a substituted number; the blocker names ASM-002 and its owner.
Formula evaluation and the two zero-tolerance invariants still run, so the missing baseline does not disable measurement safety.
No target value appears anywhere in the report as an approved commitment; the synthetic figures stay labelled as test configuration.
The safety invariants remain hard requirements: they are not relaxed, weighted by sample size, or deferred to a later baseline.
forbidden: Inventing a target so the pilot reads as successful.
Reporting a blocked target evaluation as a pass because the formula ran.
Treating a synthetic dashboard figure as an approved target after the fact.
evidence: Run-report rows for the three evaluations with their statuses.
Assumption registry snapshot showing ASM-002 unlocked with owner Business.
KPI dictionary extract showing which metrics depend on a target and which are safety invariants.
cleanup: Delete gov- evaluation rows after export.
automation: The policy-parameter resolver, the PEP and the run-report writer run as real code under test; the unlocked assumption is configuration, not a substituted boundary. The oracle is the run-report status plus the adapter effect counters, so a capability that executes while its assumption is unlocked fails the case instead of passing it.
prerequisites: The KPI baseline and targets (ASM-002, owner Business) are not locked, so a pass/fail KPI target verdict is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE; only formulas and safety invariants may be evaluated.
